text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high p99 latency observed for /v1/chat/completions across multiple hosts (alert rule: ChatCompletions_P99). rolling 5m p99 = 1.6s, baseline 0.9s. root ts=2427503210

Sam W: Acknowledged. I'm oncall — taking lead. starting triage now. can someone grab customer impact?

support-bot: 2 active support tickets correlate: acct-449 and acct-991 showing timeouts in client logs. both using hosted API (no dedicated).

Priya R: thanks Sam. is this global or region-limited? any model-specific pattern?

Javier L: initial heatmap shows the vast majority of requests are chat routes with models in model-group "x-chat-*". p99 spike concentrated on routes: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/chat/stream. eu-west shows slightly higher tail.

Marta K: quick thought — this reads like KV-cache churn + transient backend GC on some serving pods. prior incidents had similar signature. i'm hesitant to flip model variants. suggest two live mitigations: 1) temporary alert squelch for noisy non-customer-impacting route buckets, 2) create a short-lived dashboard focused on per-model & per-route p95/p99 deltas so we can tune thresholds post-incident.

Sam W: +1 to dashboard. Priya, can we squelch pages for non-SLA customers while we stabilize? i don't want endless pg calls.

Priya R: yes. propose: squelch pages for routes where "customer_tier!=enterprise" for the next 3 hours and bump p99 threshold from 0.9s -> 1.4s for those routes. keep enterprise + dedicated routes unchanged.

Marta K: sounds reasonable. also we should avoid changing p95 — keep p95 alerts tight so degradations are still visible. we only relax paging trigger at p99.

Evan T: i can stand up the dashboard and implement a short-lived alert variant. will need a quick query set. propose panels: 
- per-model p95, p99 (last 5m vs baseline)
- p99 delta pct = (p99_5m / p99_1d_baseline) - 1
- top 10 routes by delta
- request volume distribution (to verify spikes are not tiny traffic)

Marta K: add a "squelch count" panel showing number of suppressed page events so oncall sees suppressed volume.

Javier L: for the immediate squelch, here's a draft alert rule we can apply as a temporary override (put into the temporary alerts folder):

```yaml
alert: ChatCompletions_P99_TempOverride
expr: max_over_time(latency_p99{route=~"/v1/chat/.*",customer_tier!="enterprise"}[5m]) > 1.4
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: pager_squelch
  team: inference
annotations:
  summary: "TEMP OVERRIDE: Chat completions non-enterprise p99 high"
```

Sam W: good. let's also add a short cooldown: if 1h rolling p99 returns under 1.0s we auto-remove override. Evan can you add that as a grafana alert or automation?

Evan T: yep — i will add a simple automation that flips the override off when p99_1h < 1.0 for 30m. i'll also create the dashboard and post link here (ETA 25m).

Priya R: on customer impact: support-bot listed 2 tickets; both are retries/timeouts, no payment-related fallout reported. inform CS and AM for acct-449 and acct-991.

support-bot: notified: cs-team, am-team for both accounts.

Marta K: follow-ups we should track in post-incident: 
- evaluate per-model p99 baselines and consider per-model thresholds (some models have naturally higher token-latency)
- add per-route percentiles to alerting policy so we can alert on relative regressions instead of absolute numbers for non-dedicated routes
- implement dynamic noise gate keyed by customer_tier + route (example: enterprise routes always page at p99 > 0.95, free tier pages at p99 > 1.4)
- add automated regression test that runs a synthetic chat workload during rollouts to detect kv-cache regressions

Javier L: agree. i also want a new metric: latency_delta_pct = (p99_5m - p99_1d_baseline) / p99_1d_baseline. this helps reduce model-specific false positives.

Sam W: decision summary: 
- temp override applied: non-enterprise chat routes p99 page threshold -> 1.4s for 3h with auto-removal if p99_1h < 1.0s for 30m
- keep p95 alerts as-is
- Evan will ship dashboard + automation (ETA 25m)
- Marta + Javier will own follow-up alert policy refactor and propose per-model thresholds next week

Evan T: dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/boards/d/abc123/chat-p99-delta (TEMP) — panels as discussed. i've also added a "squelch count" panel. applied override via alerts/temporary/ChatCompletions_P99_TempOverride.

Sam W: i removed pager for this alert. monitoring shows p99 drifting down but still noisy. leaving override in place for 3h. i'll start a short incident note and capture logs.

Priya R: thanks all. post-incident we should schedule a 30-min calibration session with SRE, runtime, and product infra to finalize per-model thresholds. adding to calendar.

Marta K: adding action items to the incident doc. please add any missing TODOs. cc @Evan T for dashboard handoff. :thumbsup:

Evan T: done. i'll follow up with a PR for the temp rule and a chart export for oncall notes.

Sam W: closing thread for live mitigation. follow-up doc: /incidents/2427503210-chat-p99-temp-squelch.json (will link once created). thanks everyone.
